title: American Dragon: Jake Long
description: American Dragon is a coming of age comedy-action series about Jake Long, a 13-year-old Asian-American boy who strives to find balance in his life as a skateboard-grinding, New York ‘tween while learning to master his mystical powers (in his secret identity) as the American Dragon, the protector and guardian of all magical creatures secretly living amidst the human world.

episodes.title: S1-E4The Legend of the Dragon Tooth

episodes_data.title: American Dragon: Jake Long 1x1
episodes_data.description: Jake gets fed up when Grandpa puts him through a series of disgusting and seemingly pointless training exercises.

episodes_data.title: American Dragon: Jake Long 1x2
episodes_data.description: When Jake comes down with a serious case of Dragon stank breath; Fu Dog must set him up on a date for the school dance.

episodes_data.title: American Dragon: Jake Long 1x3
episodes_data.description: Jake must compete in the school talent show with Fu Dog as his ventriloquist sidekick.

episodes_data.title: American Dragon: Jake Long 1x4
episodes_data.description: Dr. Diente, the Tooth Fairy's assistant gone bad, needs Haley's first baby tooth in order to activate his doomsday tooth monster. Jake must save his sister and the day.

episodes_data.title: American Dragon: Jake Long 1x5
episodes_data.description: Wanting to get some lip-on-lip action with the honey of his dreams, Jake butchers the role of Antony to play opposite Rose's Cleopatra in the school play.

episodes_data.title: American Dragon: Jake Long 1x6
episodes_data.description: Jake must comedically hide a giant, hairy troll in his apartment for an entire day.

episodes_data.title: American Dragon: Jake Long 1x7
episodes_data.description: Fu must tangle with an evil dogcatcher in order to make his way to a baseball game.

episodes_data.title: American Dragon: Jake Long 1x8
episodes_data.description: Desperate to collect reward money to replace Trixie's mother's broken one-of-a-kind vase, Jake embarks on an attempt to provide Professor Rotwood with proof of the existence of dragons.

episodes_data.title: American Dragon: Jake Long 1x9
episodes_data.description: The Egg: When a rare Griffin egg is stolen, Jake must fight the Huntsclan to return it to its nest.

episodes_data.title: American Dragon: Jake Long 1x10
episodes_data.description: Jake, Grandpa, Trixie, Spud, and Fu Dog must comically stumble through an elaborate "Ocean's 11" style heist to retrieve a Leprechaun's stolen gold.

episodes_data.title: American Dragon: Jake Long 1x11
episodes_data.description: Jake risks losing Grandpa as his dragon master and must face the most terrifying villain of all - a dragon gone bad.

episodes_data.title: American Dragon: Jake Long 1x12
episodes_data.description: When Jake is assigned as body guard  to the Oracle Twins, their incessant visions of the future drive him nuts -- until he realizes they can use their powers to make his life easier.

episodes_data.title: American Dragon: Jake Long 1x13
episodes_data.description: When Jake gets shape-shifting powers for a dragon mission, he misuses them to get out of a parent-teacher conference and impress his peers.

episodes_data.title: American Dragon: Jake Long 1x14
episodes_data.description: When Jake, Trixie, and Spud attend a school sponsored ski trip, Jake embarks on an investigation to find out the true identity of the Huntsgirl, while also trying to get some alone time with Rose.

episodes_data.title: American Dragon: Jake Long 1x15
episodes_data.description: Jake must stop the legendary Jersey Devil from terrorizing the woodland village of earth sprites.

episodes_data.title: American Dragon: Jake Long 1x16
episodes_data.description: Fu Dog is forced to go undercover as a contestant in the "Miss Magical World." beauty pageant.

episodes_data.title: American Dragon: Jake Long 1x17
episodes_data.description: A Gremlin on the loose at Mom's big catering gig threatens to disrupt the wedding of the century.

episodes_data.title: American Dragon: Jake Long 1x18
episodes_data.description: Jake discovers that his ancient, out of touch Grandfather was once a swinging, stylin' Bruce Lee/Austin Powers-style mack daddy super-agent in 1960s Hong Kong. When Grandpa is captured by the Dark Dragon, Jake must face off against his arch foe to save him.

episodes_data.title: American Dragon: Jake Long 1x19
episodes_data.description: While Grandpa takes Haley trick or treating, Jake seizes the opportunity to throw the wildest Halloween party ever - mixing humans and magical creatures.

episodes_data.title: American Dragon: Jake Long 1x20
episodes_data.description: Fu Dog must endure the extreme indignity of Haley's elementary school class "Show And Tell", while also confronting an old nemesis.

episodes_data.title: American Dragon: Jake Long 1x21
episodes_data.description: Jake, Trixie, and Spud must transport a wild mystical female unicorn from Coney Island to Central Park during holiday rush hour whilst escaping from the freakshow carnival folk.

episodes_data.title: American Dragon: Jake Long 2x1
episodes_data.description: When Jake faces a villain named Fury, who tries to find her sisters and rule the world once again, Trixie goes undercover as a cheerleader to get information from a tight-knit squad of cheerleaders who get possessed by Fury now and again.

episodes_data.title: American Dragon: Jake Long 2x2
episodes_data.description: Jake decides to use a potion to locate Rose but when the contents end up in cupcakes baked for the school carnival, and everyone is turned into Krylock monsters, trouble ensues.

episodes_data.title: American Dragon: Jake Long 2x3
episodes_data.description: Jake and Spud stumble upon Rose while undercover at a secret Huntsclan Training School.

episodes_data.title: American Dragon: Jake Long 2x4
episodes_data.description: When Jake is overwhelmed by his hectic schedule, he begins using his dragon powers to create doppelganger copies of himself to help ease the load-with, but also creates his dark side who has plans of his own.

episodes_data.title: American Dragon: Jake Long 2x5
episodes_data.description: Jake's life is thrown into chaos when Grandpa starts dating his principal. Meanwhile, Jake learns a ferocious beast is preying on magical creatures.

episodes_data.title: American Dragon: Jake Long 2x6
episodes_data.description: Jake becomes obsessed with his appearance when he is hit by a vicious case of dragon acne. At the same time, he must work with Rose for the first time when she reveals the Huntsman's ultimate evil plan.

episodes_data.title: American Dragon: Jake Long 2x7
episodes_data.description: When Haley begins her dragon training, the sibling rivalry between Jake and Haley begins to erupt.

episodes_data.title: American Dragon: Jake Long 2x8
episodes_data.description: Jake time-travels back to the year 1986 to tell a teenage Dad the truth about magical creatures. But when Dad freaks and breaks up with Mom, it's up to Jake to get his parents back together.

episodes_data.title: American Dragon: Jake Long 2x9
episodes_data.description: Jake uses his ability to enter people's dreams to both comical and nightmarish results.

episodes_data.title: American Dragon: Jake Long 2x10
episodes_data.description: Spud gets a perfect score on a government issued standardized exam at school and is recruited to a special top-secret school called "The Genius Institute". He soon discovers that there's more to the school than meets the eye.

episodes_data.title: American Dragon: Jake Long 2x11
episodes_data.description: Jake gets sucked into the bling-bling lifestyle when he starts working for a semi-shady leprechaun clan.

episodes_data.title: American Dragon: Jake Long 2x12
episodes_data.description: When the Longs attend a Florida family reunion, Jake must deal with his annoying cousin Greggy and an aquatic villain bent on flooding half the continent.

episodes_data.title: American Dragon: Jake Long 2x13
episodes_data.description: Jake accidentally turns Haley on to the life of rebel wild child, with the help of a twisted magical children's show host who's much more sinister than he seems.

episodes_data.title: American Dragon: Jake Long 2x14
episodes_data.description: Jake's bid for student body president takes an unexpected turn when he uses a magical helmet to read the minds of his constituents.

episodes_data.title: American Dragon: Jake Long 2x15
episodes_data.description: Jake accidentally gets Rotwood fired, and ends up with a Principal who's even worse, meanwhile Spud tries to "woo" Stacey with onions.

episodes_data.title: American Dragon: Jake Long 2x16
episodes_data.description: Jake, feeling humiliated by his family's Christmas traditions, turns his back on them. But when he rescues a baby Sasquatch who was accidentally separated from his family, he learns the true meaning of Christmas.

episodes_data.title: American Dragon: Jake Long 2x17
episodes_data.description: An enchanted mirror switches the bodies of Jake and Haley for a day.

episodes_data.title: American Dragon: Jake Long 2x18
episodes_data.description: When Cupid goes on vacation, he leaves his magical bow and love arrows in Grandpa's care. Jake can't resist borrowing Cupid's equipment and using it to play matchmaker on his school's "Love Cruise".

episodes_data.title: American Dragon: Jake Long 2x19
episodes_data.description: While volunteering to mind Grandpa's shop on Chinese new year, Jake accidentally curses it with bad luck and must face the consequences.

episodes_data.title: American Dragon: Jake Long 2x20
episodes_data.description: Jake tries to use his nomination as Homecoming Prince to win back Rose.

episodes_data.title: American Dragon: Jake Long 2x21
episodes_data.description: When Jake's youth is stolen by a magical creature, he makes the most of life as a 21-year-old... until he realizes that being a grown-up isn't all fun and games.

episodes_data.title: American Dragon: Jake Long 2x22
episodes_data.description: Jake is "won" at a school bachelor auction by two girls-one pretty, one plain. He gravitates toward the pretty one, despite Trixie, Spud, Fu and Grandpa's fears that she is the siren bent on his destruction.

episodes_data.title: American Dragon: Jake Long 2x23
episodes_data.description: Spud is bitten by a magical frog, and begins to develop cool "froggy" powers. He enjoys all the perks of being part magical-that is, until #88 and #89 come 'a magical frog huntin'.

episodes_data.title: American Dragon: Jake Long 2x24
episodes_data.description: Jake's loyalty to Fu Dog comes into question when he's assigned a new animal guardian-a totally cool hip-hop helper monkey. But can Jake's perfect new pet ever take the place of Fu Dog?

episodes_data.title: American Dragon: Jake Long 2x25
episodes_data.description: Jake's venting to an online journal unintentionally turns Rotwood into the magical world's public enemy #1.

episodes_data.title: American Dragon: Jake Long 2x26
episodes_data.description: Jake, Spud, and Trixie become camp counselors. Jake must face his school nemesis Brad, as well as clan of ghosts, bent on revenge.

episodes_data.title: American Dragon: Jake Long 2x27
episodes_data.description: Dad drags Jake to the office for Take Your Child to Work Day. Jake begins the day convinced that Dad's a wimp, but witnesses his father's inner (and outer) strength against a pack of marauding vampires.

episodes_data.title: American Dragon: Jake Long 2x28
episodes_data.description: Frustrated by life's unexpected twists and turns, Jake uses a magical device which gives him the cheat codes to a perfect life. Of course, comical disastrous results ensue.

episodes_data.title: American Dragon: Jake Long 2x29
episodes_data.description: When Stacey and Nigel become an item, a jealous Spud decides to do anything to win her affection... including striking an unholy deal with Fury, the sinister gorgon.

episodes_data.title: American Dragon: Jake Long 2x30
episodes_data.description: With middle school graduation looming, a stressed Jake decides to give up his dragon powers and let Haley become the new American Dragon. But when an old foe returns, is Haley up to the task?

episodes_data.title: American Dragon: Jake Long 2x31
episodes_data.description: Jake and the entire family head to Hong Kong for summer vacation, but must face off against the dreaded Dark Dragon when Grandpa is kidnapped.
